sources.locator: "Operation Gothic Serpent", revision 1375741255, § Battle of Mogadishu

explanation: The battle was this operation's own raid running out of control: "On 3 October 1993, the task force executed a mission to capture two of Aidid's lieutenants. The mission ultimately culminated in what became known as the Battle of Mogadishu." The article then reads the consequence back the other way — "The intensity of the battle prompted the effective termination of the operation on 6 October 1993" — so the two are the same week seen from either end, and the operation is what put 160 men in the Black Sea neighbourhood that afternoon. Probable: Wikipedia alone.
